title: Menekülthullám és nemzeti trauma (National Trauma & Memory)
grammar: Causal-Consequence Discourse, Treaty Formulations & Transnational Identity Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the refugees and the 'wagon dwellers' of the early 1920s.
I can say why people left their homes, using mert.
I can use the words for the refugee wave, trauma and territorial revision.
I can read a short account of the refugees and answer questions about it.
